title: piece of advice from a 21 year old
description:
I’m 21, and I definitely don’t have life figured out. But somewhere between figuring out college, chasing ambitions, making mistakes, and just growing up, I’ve learned a few things.

This isn’t a guide to life, and I’m definitely not here to tell you how to live yours. Just a few thoughts, a little perspective, and one piece of advice from someone who’s figuring it out too.

Maybe you’ll relate. Maybe you won’t. Either way, I hope you take something away from this.

Thanks for being here.

#lifeadvice  #LifeAt21 #personalgrowth

title: In Brightest Day… In Blackest Night… | LANTERNS
description:
In Brightest Day… In Blackest Night… 🟢

Lanterns is finally here — and this isn’t the Green Lantern story I expected.

From Hal Jordan and John Stewart to the murder mystery at the heart of the story, Lanterns takes the DC Universe in a surprisingly grounded direction.

In this video, we talk about the story, the characters, the mystery, the emotional journey of Hal and John, and THAT ending.

Is John Stewart ready to carry the legacy of the Green Lantern?

Or is becoming a hero about something much deeper than just wearing the ring?

⚠️ SPOILERS AHEAD.

If you enjoyed the video, hit LIKE, drop your thoughts in the comments, and SUBSCRIBE for more movie & series breakdowns, reviews and theories.

And maybe, in the end…

it was easier to fly than to stay grounded.

🟢

title: am i cooked chat…??? (ppo got rejected)
description:
I lost my PPO (Pre-Placement Offer) at Texas Instruments (TI), and honestly, I am completely cooked.

I went from thinking my near future was completely secure to being right back at square one. In this video, I’m being 100% transparent about the corporate rejection, the intense rage, and the grumpy, frustrated headspace I’ve been stuck in ever since getting the news.

If you've ever had a corporate door slammed in your face at the last second, or if you're currently navigating the brutal tech hiring market, you are not alone. Let's talk about it in the comments. Am I cooked, chat?

#CareerUpdate #TI #PrePlacementOffer #TechLayoffs #CorporateRejection #Unemployed #EngineeringLife #AmICooked
